The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-heal-reserve-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: after borg-reborn-rs #491 / PR #496, the owner asked for a zoo pilot to calibrate the healing reserve and healing speed parameters.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read. Pilot only (RULES 14); small and larger only after this
gate and the owner. Gate: no config_error; one binary; the three borg_param_town_heal_* lines with the
arm's values written in the borg.txt of every arm; no plan loaded; every cell ends in death,
turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn stalls and key outliers listed. Control r0-s0 is the town
planner's healing before #491 (the curve alone); r400-s66 is the shipped value. Report per arm:
deaths, final level, deepest level, keys; healing potions bought (Cure Light/Serious/Critical
Wounds, Healing) and gold on them against total gold spent; paired rescued and newly killed for each
arm against the control on the same start, and the cells where play diverges. Watch level-1 casters
with very low max HP at r800 (a 10-HP mage spent its starting gold on 8 Cure Light Wounds and died
in borg-reborn-rs CI). 18 starts per arm cannot show which value is best.
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main 7e08c920, which healing reserve (0, 400, 800 percent of max HP) and healing speed (0, 66) should the town planner use?
